- Ask AI in the menu of a message: Gemini, Claude, ChatGPT, DeepSeek or Grok in an MZGram window of its own, with a sign-in profile apart from Telegram's. You sign in with your own account; MZGram puts the prompt and the message into the site's field and nothing is sent until you press Send on the site.
- Ask AI takes several selected messages and the photos and files of the messages: up to 10 in all, each up to 30 MB. The box lists them and says what was left out and why. A site uploads attachments to its servers as soon as they are added, before you press Send.
- The selection bar has an Ask AI button next to Forward and Delete; the warning is shown only the first time.
- Settings > MZGram > AI: a button in the main menu for each AI site, which opens it without a message. Off by default. A site opened this way has no empty bar above the page.
- Archive: Keep messages from (users, bots, groups, channels, all on by default), the archive's size at the top of the Archive topic, and Download in advance: a message is kept as it comes and its file is downloaded at once up to a limit for each kind of chat (users 300 MB, bots 5 MB, groups 20 MB, channels 5 MB, or No limit), and up to 100 MB more when it is deleted. Before, every file was downloaded whatever its size. Counters of saved, not downloaded and expired files, with Reset counters.
- Deleting the whole archive closes the box at once, deletes the files in the background, then says how much was freed.
- Settings > MZGram > Interface > Show ID: the ID of a user, bot, group or channel in its profile, also your own in the header of Settings; a click copies it. Hidden by default.
- Windows: characters of names that the usual font has no glyphs for, as Old Turkic runes, Gothic or Egyptian hieroglyphs, are drawn with Windows' own Segoe UI Historic instead of squares.
- Settings > MZGram > Interface: switches that hide Telegram Premium, My Stars, Gram Earnings, Telegram Business, Premium Gifting, Telegram FAQ, Telegram Features and Ask a Question in Telegram's Settings and its search.
- Settings > MZGram lists its topics as on Android; the new Other topic holds Check for updates and, on Windows, Unblock MZGram files. The note under the topics is gone.
- Message menu: Copy Photo, Delete Downloaded File and Forward without sender, as on Android. The MZGram items are in the menu of a message in the main chat too.
- MZGram language: Same as Telegram is the new default, so MZGram's texts follow Telegram Desktop's language. A language chosen before is kept.
- Windows: Settings > MZGram > Other > Unblock MZGram files removes the "downloaded from the internet" mark from MZGram's files, only when you press it and after a warning. Windows protection stays on.
